title: Checkout service dependency topology
resolution: Investigate direct dependencies and distinguish primary failures from propagated symptoms.
pattern: checkout fan-out to payment, Redis and Postgres
diagnostic: Compare each dependency's metrics and errors in the same time window.
text: Synthetic V2 architecture. frontend -> checkout-service -> payment-service -> bank-api. checkout-service also depends on redis and postgres. Payment errors can propagate from bank-api while Redis failures may increase Postgres load. A topology relationship guides tool selection; it does not establish which component caused an incident. Preserve source timestamps when building the investigation timeline.
